children.text: This is the first test post on my new personal blog.
I’m using this space to write about software development, infrastructure, security, engineering decisions, and lessons learned from real projects.
The goal is to keep the blog practical: less theory for the sake of theory, and more focus on decisions, tradeoffs, mistakes, and what actually worked.
For now, this post is mainly here to verify that the publishing flow works correctly from Sanity to the live website.
If you can read this, the CMS is working.

excerpt: A quick test post to verify the publishing flow between Sanity and my personal website.
title: Building My Personal Blog
